setting.engine.title: Engine
setting.engine.desc: This plugin replaces SiYuan's built-in Mermaid 11.16.1 with the official 12.3.0. Code blocks are still rendered by SiYuan's native pipeline.
setting.enabled.title: Enable Mermaid 12 rendering
setting.enabled.desc: Turn off to hand rendering straight back to the built-in 11.16.1 and re-render the current document.
setting.theme.title: Theme
setting.theme.desc: auto follows SiYuan's light/dark mode, same as the built-in behaviour.
setting.look.title: Look
setting.look.desc: handDrawn for a sketchy look, neo for the new Mermaid 12 style.
setting.fontSize.title: Font size
setting.fontSize.desc: Base font size of the diagrams, in px. At the default 16 each theme keeps its own size; changing it scales every diagram uniformly.
setting.htmlLabels.title: HTML labels
setting.htmlLabels.desc: When enabled, node text supports inline Markdown (bold, code, …). Disable to use plain SVG text.
setting.useMaxWidth.title: Fit to width
setting.useMaxWidth.desc: Constrain diagram width to the code block width.
setting.sequenceNumbers.title: Sequence numbers
setting.sequenceNumbers.desc: Show sequence numbers in sequence diagrams, same as the built-in behaviour.
setting.maxTextSize.title: Max source size
setting.maxTextSize.desc: Maximum number of characters allowed in a single Mermaid code block.
setting.maxEdges.title: Max edges
setting.maxEdges.desc: Rendering fails beyond this limit; protects against huge diagrams.
setting.action.title: Apply now
setting.action.desc: Re-render the Mermaid diagrams in the current document immediately.
topbar.title: Mermaid 12 renderer
toast.none: No rendered Mermaid diagram in this document
toast.disabled: Handed rendering back to SiYuan, re-rendering…
toast.needReload: Enabled. Reload the UI (Ctrl+R) to apply.
